thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — our QuickHits prefill experiment shows a weird latency step when hit-rate > 0.6.
maria: After the 2.3 runtime kernel swap yesterday, p99 tokens jumped ~18ms on cpu/gpu mixtures during cache hits.
cheng: hmm, do you have flamegraphs / perf output?
maria: yes — ran a short profile on canary. paste:
```
flame: serving_loop -> kv_lookup -> kernel_dispatch (cuda_kernel_v2) -> memcpy
p99 delta: +18ms
cpu-bound time during miss unchanged
```
sam: is kernel_v2 the new fused attention variant? that one regressed on small seq lengths earlier
maria: yes. hypothesis: kernel selection prefers v2 when seq <= 64; but with KV hits we short-circuit much of attention and kernel_v1 was faster.
alesha: interesting, so cache hits change hot path shape. did batching heuristics affect kernel choice?
maria: batching heuristic will pack by sequence length and model_stage; since hits reduce compute, batches with mixed seq end up routed to v2
ops-bot: deploy notice: autoscaler event at 1738887000 triggered scale-up 3->6 nodes due to traffic spike
cheng: that autoscale/mix might have increased fraction of warm nodes with different env (driver/runtime), amplifying mismatch
maria: also saw hit-rate skew across shards — some nodes 0.8, others 0.2. uneven prefill / seeding.
sam: do we have prefill schedule logs? maybe scheduled jobs didn't target all shards after deploy.
maria: yes. schedule snippet:
```
# prefill job config
selector: "service=quickhits"
jobs:
  - cron: "0 */4 * * *"
    mode: targeted
    budget_tokens: 50k
```
maria: but deploy-time warmer didn't run on the new nodes because the deploy label changed (metadata v=2.1 -> v=2.2)
alesha: classic label mismatch. can we fallback to synthetic traffic during autoscale?
cheng: propose two small fixes:
- revert kernel_v2 selection rule for seq<=64 until we validate with high-hit paths
- make prefill job resilient: use selector by service name + fallback to pod-age < 15m
sam: + add a short synthetic primer run on scale-up event (100 qps, 30s, rng prompt set)
maria: perf test plan:
- A/B kernel selection on canary with KV hit simulation (grpc replay)
- run prefill with new selector across shards
- measure p50/p95/p99 and token-cost delta
ops-bot: created ticket INF-1987 for the A/B and INF-1988 for prefill selector change
maria: will roll canary tomorrow 09:00 PT. ping me if you want to join the run.
alesha: I'll own synthetic primer run. will post scripts.
sam: thanks — also add export of keying entropy per shard to help find skew.
maria: noted. next sync in #eng-runtime tomorrow.
